changelog:
- Major update: Improved documentation and user guidance for setup and emergency notification.
- Added detailed first-time configuration instructions for required environment variables and permissions.
- Clarified steps for notifying yourself or others, including user identification via phone/email and open_id lookup.
- Provided troubleshooting table for common errors and explicit instructions for application/permission setup on Feishu.
- Specified supported urgent methods (in-app urgent push and real phone call).
- Outlined all required Feishu app permissions for proper use.
- Included new quick start guide, usage scenarios, and sample feedback formats for notification results.
